name: Russian Pavilion at the Venice Biennale
known: Artists Savchenkov, Sukhareva and curator Malašauskas quit in Feb 2022.

name: Venice Biennale
known: The 61st Art Exhibition, "In Minor Keys", curated by Koyo Kouoh, runs 9 May to 22 November 2026 (Wikipedia).

name: Kingston Creative
known: Andrea Dempster Chung, now executive director, co-founded it with Alan Daisley and Jennifer Bailey (Jamaica Observer, 2024).

name: National Gallery of Jamaica
known: David Boxer was the first director (appointed 1975).
Veerle Poupeye was Executive Director from 2009 until she resigned in January 2018 (Wikipedia).

name: Beppu Contemporary Art Festival
known: Takashi Serizawa of P3 was general director in 2009 and 2012 (P3).

name: Hakone Open-Air Museum
known: The museum website names Nobutaka Shikanai as its founder and first director, who aimed to "contribute to the development of sculpture" because no museum devoted to sculpture existed in Japan.
Japanese Wikipedia calls him chairman of the Fujisankei Group.

name: Pola Museum of Art
known: Built to show about 9,500 works collected over decades by Tsuneji Suzuki, second head of the Pola founding family.
The Pola Art Foundation operates the museum and also runs overseas internships for young artists, research programmes for curators and international exchange (Mecenat Association).
Japanese Wikipedia says the museum opened in September 2002 to display the collection of Tsuneji Suzuki, second head of the Pola founding family;
English Wikipedia says the works were acquired by the former head of the Pola cosmetics group.

name: Hiroshima City Museum of Contemporary Art
Ohara Museum of Art
known: The building was completed on 5 November 1930 and Takeuchi Kiyomi was its first director (museum history page).
Representative director: Ohara Akane (foundation website).

It says the foundation needs continuing renovation to preserve and show its works and seeks corporate partners for four purposes: the viewing environment, young artists, children's creativity and conservation (translated summary).
Its activities include conservation and research of the works and upkeep of facilities (museum website).
Its foundation posts yearly business reports for 2024 and 2025, financial statements and a director list; partners are logos dated April 2026.

name: Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art
Art Tower Mito
known: Directors have been critic Yoshida Hidekazu (吉田秀和), conductor Seiji Ozawa and now Katayama Morihide (片山杜秀).
Its chair is Fukuda (福田三千男).

name: Aichi Triennale
known: Organised by the International Art Festival Aichi Organizing Committee, chaired in 2025 by Takeo Obayashi, chairman of Obayashi Corporation.

The 2025 edition, "A Time Between Ashes and Roses", ran from 13 September to 30 November 2025 under artistic director Hoor Al Qasimi, at the Aichi Arts Center, the Aichi Prefectural Ceramic Museum and the streets of Seto.
Shabbir Hussain Mustafa was named artistic director for Aichi 2028 in July 2026.
Aichi Triennale posts event reports for 2019 and 2025, the 2025 one with committee income and spending and named sponsors; it names only its chair.

name: Benesse Art Site Naoshima
known: Soichiro Fukutake, Honorary Chairman of the Fukutake Foundation and General Producer of the Setouchi Triennale, began visiting Naoshima to continue his father's project of building a children's campsite there (stated by Benesse Art Site).
Cultural revitalization initiative across Naoshima, Teshima, and Inujima founded by Soichiro Fukutake.

name: Okayama Art Summit
known: The first edition ran from 9 October to 27 November 2016 on the theme "Development", with Liam Gillick as artistic director (festival website).
Organised by the Okayama Art Summit Executive Committee, chaired by Okayama's mayor Masao Omori (festival website).
Rirkrit Tiravanija was artistic director of the 2022 edition (30 September to 27 November 2022).
Yasuharu Ishikawa, president of the Ishikawa Foundation, is executive producer of the 2025 edition and Taro Nasu of the gallery TARO NASU is executive director (festival website).
